title: Joshua conquers Canaan
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 1): 1450 BC (CFAH). Sort changed by the Reply to Beckman pass (2026-11-13): was provisional 1450 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 1: Jewish Sources for the Chronology of the Divided Kingdom," OSF preprint v1.4 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/XJZBM, section “Midrashic Literature”, item 3 (850 + 14 years), p. 7
chronologies.note: Conquest date of CFAH (1450–586 BC), beside Ussher 1451 and Jones 1451.
